summary.plain: The United States' national laboratory for accelerator-based science at Stanford University, in Menlo Park, California. It built the world's longest linear accelerator and later ran two colliders, SLC and PEP-II, that produced Nobel-Prize-winning physics.
summary.technical: DOE Office of Science national laboratory (Menlo Park, California), administered by Stanford University; historically home to the 3.2 km SLAC linac (up to 50 GeV electrons), the SLC electron-positron collider (1989-1998) and the PEP-II B-factory (1999-2008).
